goalcraft_gates.name: 无占位
goalcraft_gates.rule: Missing school constraints, actual inputs and output specifications remain missing; cannot compile executable production tasks.

goalcraft_gates.name: 命令真实
goalcraft_gates.rule: Executable commands must exist in the bound capability version and have a recorded self-test; unknown adapters remain proposed.

goalcraft_gates.name: 可观察
goalcraft_gates.rule: Every task has observable output, evidence references and a check contract; prose assurances cannot mark passed.

goalcraft_gates.name: 权限诚实
goalcraft_gates.rule: Capability availability and execution scope must match the worker; cannot claim cloud Linux can operate an unbound Windows CAD session.

change_propagation.algorithm: traverse declared depends_on edges from changed artifact version; mark descendants stale; preserve unrelated branches
change_propagation.granularity: object or section when explicit provenance exists; otherwise conservative file-level invalidation
change_propagation.recheck: recompute affected nodes under new generation; run two independent checks; user confirms affected delivery manifest
